_comment: Gloss paint: a white high-gloss enamel or alkyd, as on doors, trim, railings and appliances, authored white so a Creator tints it to any colour (author light). OPAQUE with the OpenPBR coat (Phase07; MasterSet row 1 lists clearcoat as an Opaque param): the pigmented paint film is a satin body under a smooth, clear binder-rich surface, so the paint shows a broad soft sheen with a sharp mirror highlight on top, the wet look that makes gloss paint read as gloss. Carries every relevant wear layer at 0 (C1): scratches (overlay 1, damage), dust as a deposit (Phase10), fingerprints, placed by the Edges mask, whose channels fit the row's order (G damage along borders, B deposit in corners, A handling on open faces). Built by the Phase11 batch.
name: Paint_Gloss_Clean_Base_s01_v01

sources.note: A whiteboard is a white gloss coating on steel: its colour is taken as the paint's and its IOR 1.5 as the coat's (coat_ior). Its roughness 0 is not taken: see the judgement below.

sources.why: roughness_const 0.3 for the pigmented film under the gloss surface (a satin body), with coat_weight 1 for a full gloss finish; coat_roughness 0.05, since a brushed or sprayed gloss enamel is not optically flat (orange peel, micro-roughness; at 0 the rig's light reflected as an unresolved point and the gloss did not read); Physically Based's Car Paint gives the same IOR 1.5 for an acrylic enamel's clear top.
